title: LesonPaw
description: A multi-language online learning platform connecting students with professional tutors through both virtual and in-person sessions, designed to make quality education accessible across Haiti. And Admin controlled Administration included.
role: Full-Stack Development, UI/UX Design, System Architecture
content:
# LesonPaw – Online Learning Platform

## Project Overview

**LesonPaw** is a role-based online learning platform designed to connect students with professional tutors through both virtual and in-person learning experiences. The project was built with a strong focus on **scalability, performance, and clarity of user roles**, ensuring that every type of user interacts only with what they are authorized to access.

The client approached us with a clear vision: a **secure, multi-language education platform** with distinct user experiences for administrators, teachers, and students. Our role was to translate this vision into a **robust, production-ready system**, delivering every requested feature with precision and reliability.

---

## Project Goals

- Build a **scalable learning platform** capable of supporting multiple user roles.
- Ensure **strict role-based access control** for Admin, Teacher, and Student accounts.
- Provide a **clean, intuitive user experience** across all dashboards.
- Support **multi-language accessibility** for a diverse user base.
- Deliver a **fast, modern, and SEO-friendly** web application.
- Maintain flexibility so the platform can grow with future requirements.

---

## Key Challenges

### 1. Role-Based Architecture
Designing a system where **each role has completely separate authority and dashboard access** required careful planning. Admins needed full system control, teachers required service and schedule management, and students needed a frictionless learning and booking experience — all without overlap or security risk.

![Gallery 4](https://i.ibb.co/YFzkhkKn/iconic-app-1.png)

### 2. Authorization & Security
Implementing **secure authentication and authorization** was critical. We ensured that protected routes, APIs, and dashboards were accessible only to the correct roles using token-based authentication and server-side checks.

### 3. Client-Driven Customization
The client actively guided feature decisions and UX behavior. Each requirement was analyzed, validated, and implemented with **full alignment to the client’s expectations**, while still maintaining best engineering practices.

### 4. Performance & Scalability
Handling real-time interactions, bookings, and data flow required a highly optimized frontend and a reliable backend structure that could scale as usage grows.

![Gallery 2](https://i.ibb.co/hxz9kWjQ/iconic-app-4.png)

---

## Role-Based System Design

### Administrator
- Full platform authority and configuration access
- User and tutor approval management
- Payment and transaction monitoring
- Content, blog, and system analytics control
- System-wide data visibility

![Gallery 4](https://i.ibb.co/YFzkhkKn/iconic-app-1.png)

### Teacher
- Professional profile and service management
- Availability and schedule control
- Student job browsing and applications
- Session management and earnings tracking

![Gallery 3](https://i.ibb.co/m5DzX00X/iconic-app-2.png)

### Student
- Tutor discovery and filtering
- Session booking and management
- Custom job posting for learning needs
- Progress and activity tracking

Each role operates within **clearly defined boundaries**, ensuring security, clarity, and ease of use.

---

## Our Approach

We followed a **client-centric development process**:

1. Requirement analysis and role mapping  
2. System architecture and data modeling  
3. UI/UX design aligned with real user workflows  
4. Incremental feature delivery and testing  
5. Client feedback integration at every stage  
6. Final optimization, security hardening, and deployment  

The result is a platform that not only meets requirements but is **ready for long-term growth**.

---
![Gallery 3](https://i.ibb.co/m5DzX00X/iconic-app-2.png)

## Technology Stack

### Frontend
- **Next.js** – Server-side rendering, routing, and SEO optimization
- **React.js** – Component-driven UI architecture
- **Tailwind CSS** – Clean, scalable design system
- **Framer Motion** – Smooth UI interactions and transitions
- **i18n** – Multi-language support
- **Axios / React Query** – Efficient data fetching and state handling

### Backend
- **Node.js & Express.js** – API and server logic
- **MongoDB** – Flexible and scalable database
- **Firebase Authentication** – Secure login and identity management
- **JWT Authorization** – Role-based access control
- **RESTful APIs** – Clean, maintainable communication layer

![Gallery 6](https://i.ibb.co/fdPqSbt0/Mockup-by-Mockuuups-Studio.png)

---
![Gallery 3](https://i.ibb.co/m5DzX00X/iconic-app-2.png)

## Design & UX Philosophy

- Minimal and distraction-free interface
- Clear visual hierarchy for complex dashboards
- Consistent components across all roles
- Mobile-first and fully responsive design
- Fast load times and smooth navigation

---

## Outcome

LesonPaw was delivered with **full feature fulfillment**, aligned precisely with the client’s vision. The platform now operates as a **secure, scalable, and user-friendly learning ecosystem**, ready to support students, teachers, and administrators at scale.
![Gallery 5](https://i.ibb.co/bgDtnRbd/Mockup-by-Mockuuups-Studio-1.png)

---

## Credits

Designed and developed by **Foxmen Studio**, handling:
- System Architecture
- Full-Stack Development
- UI/UX Design
- Role-Based Security Implementation
- Deployment & Optimization

title: BIRSTBD
description: BIRSTBD is an academic-focused digital platform supporting students and researchers through seminars, expert-led training, AI-powered research tools, and personalized learning dashboards—designed to strengthen research capacity in Bangladesh. It is the world’s first research-dedicated web application with fully integrated AI tools.
role: UI/UX Design • Full-Stack Web Development • Research Platform Architecture • Deployment • System Design
content:
# Bangladesh Institute for Research and Statistical Training (BIRSTBD)

## Project Overview
**BIRSTBD** is a next-generation AI-powered Learning Management and Research Platform designed to transform how students, researchers, and educators engage with research, statistics, and academic training. The system combines a full-scale LMS, multi-role administration, and a network of intelligent AI agents—making it one of the most advanced research-focused EdTech platforms in Bangladesh.

Built for scale, speed, and security, BIRSTBD supports thousands of concurrent users while delivering personalized, research-driven experiences.
![Gallery 4](https://i.ibb.co/V0ZSxxT0/iconic-app-6.png)
---

## The Challenge
Modern research education faces several critical gaps:
- Fragmented research resources
- Lack of personalized guidance for students
- Manual and inefficient seminar & course management
- No centralized system for publishing research, blogs, and learning materials
- Poor engagement and delayed communication between institutions and learners

Our goal was to design and engineer a **single unified platform** that could solve all of these challenges—while remaining fast, secure, and future-ready.
![Gallery 7](https://i.ibb.co/Z6HpGGNL/agent-5.png)

---

## The Solution
BIRSTBD was architected as a **full-stack, AI-integrated LMS and Research Ecosystem** with:

- Role-based access control (Admin, Moderator, Student)
- Event, seminar, and workshop management
- Research paper & blog publishing
- AI-assisted research and statistical guidance
- Real-time notifications and communication
- Enterprise-grade authentication and security

At its core, the platform is powered by **9+ active AI agents** and a centralized intelligent assistant called **BIRST AI**.
![Gallery 6](https://i.ibb.co/7NzHjcWj/agent-6.png)
---

## Key Features

### 1. Multi-Role System Architecture
- **Admin Panel**
  - Create and manage moderators and students
  - Approve users and control access levels
  - Publish courses, seminars, workshops, blogs, and resources
![Gallery 3](https://i.ibb.co/9kQzknCx/iconic-app-8.png)
- **Moderator Panel**
  - Manage content, events, and academic materials
  - Communicate directly with participants
- **Student Panel**
  - Personalized dashboard
  - Track learning progress
  - Publish blogs, research papers, and resources
  - Receive real-time notifications
![Gallery 2](https://i.ibb.co/kV4DMhb5/iconic-app-9.png)
---

### 2. Advanced AI Agent Ecosystem
BIRSTBD integrates **9+ specialized AI agents**, each dedicated to specific research and academic tasks:
![Gallery 1](https://i.ibb.co/YFxNPMC1/agent-2.png)
- Research methodology support
- Statistical analysis guidance
- Literature review assistance
- Data interpretation
- Academic writing support
- Platform navigation and discovery
- Training recommendations
- Event and course guidance
- Productivity optimization

#### BIRST AI (Dedicated Assistant)
A centralized, intelligent AI assistant that:
- Learns user behavior over time
- Provides personalized research guidance
- Answers questions about courses, faculty, founders, and resources
- Instantly guides users to relevant sections and links
- Assists with daily academic and research needs

---

### 3. Full Learning Management System (LMS)
- Structured courses with modules and sessions
- Live and recorded seminar integration
- Workshop and event scheduling
- Automated participant notifications
- Progress tracking and learning analytics
![Gallery 3](https://i.ibb.co/9kQzknCx/iconic-app-8.png)

---

### 4. Research Publishing & Resource Hub
- User-generated blogs and research papers
- Academic resource sharing
- Centralized knowledge base
- Version control and content moderation

---

### 5. Real-Time Notifications & Communication
- Event creation, updates, and cancellations
- Seminar reminders
- Direct admin/moderator contact system
- Dedicated support channels for immediate help

---

## System Design & Architecture

### Frontend
- **Next.js** for high-performance server-side rendering
- Component-driven UI architecture
- Responsive, modern, and accessible design

### Backend
- **Node.js** for scalable API services
- Role-based authorization and secure routing
- Real-time data handling and event triggers

### Database
- **Neon (PostgreSQL)** for high-performance relational data
- Optimized queries for concurrent users
- Secure data isolation and integrity

### Authentication & Security
![Gallery 8](https://i.ibb.co/1YtkBrFp/agent-3.png)
- **Firebase Authentication**
- Secure login, role validation, and session handling
- Cyber-security–certified architecture
- Protected routes and encrypted communication

### Infrastructure & Deployment
- **Dockerized services** for consistency and scalability
- Cloud-based hosting
- Load-balanced environment supporting high traffic
- Optimized for simultaneous multi-user access

---

## Performance & Scalability
- Designed to handle **large numbers of concurrent users**
- Modular microservice-friendly architecture
- Fast response times and minimal latency
- Built for long-term expansion and AI evolution

---

## Complexity & Engineering Challenges
![Gallery 5](https://i.ibb.co/VYnRGtjW/agent-1.png)
This project required solving:
- Multi-role access control with strict security
- AI agent orchestration and coordination
- Personalized AI behavior over time
- Real-time notifications at scale
- Secure content publishing workflows
- High availability under heavy load

Each system component was carefully engineered to ensure reliability, performance, and extensibility.

---

## Impact & Vision
BIRSTBD is not just a website—it is a **research-first digital ecosystem**.

By combining AI agents, LMS infrastructure, and research tools, the platform:
- Empowers students to become confident researchers
- Simplifies academic administration
- Promotes data literacy and statistical excellence
- Positions itself as a future-ready EdTech solution for 2026 and beyond

---

## Technology Stack
- **Next.js**
- **Node.js**
- **Docker**
- **Neon (PostgreSQL)**
- **Firebase Authentication**
- **Cloud Infrastructure**
- **AI Agent Frameworks**
- **Front End Development**
- **Backend Development**

---

## Conclusion
BIRSTBD represents a new standard for research and statistical training platforms—where **AI, education, and scalability converge**.  
A complex system, thoughtfully designed and expertly built, dedicated to advancing research excellence in the modern academic era.

title: STATISTICS-NSTU
description: A full-featured, real-time academic management platform designed for the Department of Statistics at Noakhali Science and Technology University. The system centralizes academic information, student and faculty data, notices, seminars, and administrative operations into a single, modern web application.
content:
## Department of Statistics — NSTU Digital Academic Platform

### Project Overview
This project is a comprehensive, real-time academic management platform developed for the Department of Statistics at Noakhali Science and Technology University (NSTU). The platform centralizes all departmental operations—academic data, student and faculty management, notices, seminars, and communication—into a single, secure, and scalable web application.

The system is designed to serve multiple user roles (Admin, Faculty, Students, Public Users) while maintaining high performance, data accuracy, and accessibility across devices.

---

## Problem Statement
The department previously depended on manual workflows and fragmented digital tools to manage academic records, notices, and communication. This resulted in:
- Data inconsistency and outdated information  
- High administrative workload  
- Limited accessibility for students and faculty  
- Lack of a centralized digital system  

A modern, scalable, and real-time solution was required to digitize departmental operations and improve efficiency.

---

## Solution Overview
We designed and developed a role-based academic platform that consolidates all departmental data into a unified system. The solution ensures real-time updates, secure access, and a clean, intuitive user experience tailored to each user type.

The platform is fully responsive, optimized for performance, and built with future scalability in mind.

---
![Gallery 2](https://i.ibb.co/svvqQH0d/iconic-app-11.png)
## System Architecture
The platform follows a modular, service-oriented architecture:

- **Frontend Layer**  
  A responsive UI with reusable components and optimized layouts for desktop and mobile.

- **Backend Layer**  
  Secure API-driven architecture handling authentication, authorization, and data operations.

- **Database Layer**  
  Structured relational database ensuring data integrity and real-time synchronization.

- **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**  
  Different permissions for Admin, Faculty, Students, and Public Users.

Each module is decoupled yet interconnected, allowing independent scaling and maintenance.

---
![Gallery 1](https://i.ibb.co/cKh1Jn3c/iconic-app-10.png)

## Core Modules & Features

### Admin Management System
- Centralized dashboard for full system control  
- Manage students, faculty, batches, notices, seminars, and resources  
- Real-time data updates and content moderation  

### Student Portal
![Gallery 6](https://i.ibb.co/fzRHQ7cM/iconic-app-16.png)
- Batch-wise and individual student profiles  
- Academic and personal information management  
- Search and filtering for quick access  

![Gallery 4](https://i.ibb.co/ds0pknbW/iconic-app-13.png)
### Faculty Management
- Faculty profiles with designation, education, and research interests  
- Contact information and academic roles  
- Structured faculty listing and profile pages  

### Notice Board
- Real-time publishing of academic and administrative notices  
- Centralized announcement system accessible to all users  

### Library & Seminar Library
![Gallery 6](https://i.ibb.co/fzRHQ7cM/iconic-app-16.png)
- Digital repository for academic resources  
- Seminar archive management with structured data  
- Easy navigation and future expandability  

### AI Assistant (ChiChat)
![Gallery 2](https://i.ibb.co/svvqQH0d/iconic-app-11.png)
- Intelligent assistant for instant academic queries  
- Provides information about faculty, students, seminars, and department details  
- Enhances user experience and reduces manual inquiries  

### Contact & Communication
![Gallery 5](https://i.ibb.co/qMJ8gBS4/iconic-app-14.png)
- Centralized contact system for inquiries  
- Organized departmental contact information  

---

## Design Approach
- Clean, academic-focused UI with minimal visual noise  
- Consistent typography, spacing, and color system  
- Mobile-first responsive design  
- Accessibility-focused layout for usability across devices  

Design decisions prioritized clarity, readability, and ease of navigation.

---

## Tech Stack

### Frontend
- HTML5  
- CSS3 / Modern UI Styling  
- TypeScript  
- Responsive Layout System  

### Backend
- Django (Python)  
- RESTful API Architecture  
- Secure Authentication & Authorization  

### Database
- PostgreSQL  
- Structured relational schema  
- Optimized queries for performance  

### AI & Automation
- AI-powered chatbot integration  
- Knowledge-based response system  

### Design Tools
- Figma (UI/UX Design)  
- Framer (Prototyping & Interaction)  

### Development & Deployment
- Git & GitHub (Version Control)  
- Cloud-based Hosting  
- Production-grade server configuration  

---

## Performance & Optimization
- Optimized database queries for faster response times  
- Lazy loading and efficient data fetching  
- Modular codebase for maintainability  
- Secure handling of user data and access permissions  

---

## Outcome & Impact
- Fully digitized departmental operations  
- Reduced administrative workload  
- Improved data accuracy and accessibility  
- Real-time communication across the department  
- Scalable foundation for future academic features  

---

## Conclusion
This project demonstrates FOXMEN Studio’s capability to design and build complex, real-time academic platforms with a strong focus on usability, scalability, and performance. The system now serves as a centralized digital backbone for the department’s academic and administrative activities.

title: HorseHub AI - APP
description: HorseHub AI is a modern mobile marketplace designed for buying, selling, and managing horses with confidence. The app combines a clean, user-friendly UI with powerful AI features such as a personal assistant, smart horse listings, and expert recommendations. Users can explore verified horse listings, view detailed profiles, connect with trusted sellers, and access veterinary services—all within a seamless mobile experience. HorseHub AI modernizes the traditional horse trading ecosystem through intelligent automation, secure authentication, and an intuitive design system.
role: Mobile App Development, UI/UX, Database management
content:
## Overview

HorseHub AI is a full-scale mobile marketplace application designed to modernize the horse buying and selling ecosystem. Our goal was to combine **e-commerce functionality**, **AI-powered assistance**, and a **trust-driven marketplace** into a single, seamless experience that works flawlessly across **iOS and Android** platforms.

From the very beginning, we focused on building an app that feels **premium, reliable, and human-centered**, while still being technically robust and scalable.
## Overview

HorseHub AI is a full-scale mobile marketplace application designed to modernize the horse buying and selling ecosystem. Our goal was to combine **e-commerce functionality**, **AI-powered assistance**, and a **trust-driven marketplace** into a single, seamless experience that works flawlessly across **iOS and Android** platforms.

From the very beginning, we focused on building an app that feels **premium, reliable, and human-centered**, while still being technically robust and scalable.
![Gallery 3](https://i.ibb.co/HD8kGbvN/Frame-1-5.png)
---

## Our Vision & Goal

The core goal of HorseHub AI was to solve three major challenges in traditional horse trading:

1. Lack of trust between buyers and sellers  
2. Scattered information and poor listing quality  
3. No intelligent guidance for users unfamiliar with horses  

We aimed to create a platform where users can:
- Discover verified horse listings with confidence
- Receive intelligent guidance through an AI assistant
- Complete transactions securely using modern payment systems
- Access professionals such as veterinarians and service providers

HorseHub AI was designed not just as an app, but as a **digital ecosystem for horse enthusiasts**.

---

## User Experience & Product Feel

We intentionally designed HorseHub AI to feel:
- **Warm and trustworthy**, using neutral tones and soft contrasts
- **Simple yet powerful**, avoiding unnecessary complexity
- **Guided**, with clear CTAs and AI-driven suggestions

Every screen was crafted to reduce friction—from onboarding and authentication to browsing listings and contacting sellers. The AI assistant plays a key role in enhancing this experience by guiding users, answering questions, and helping them make informed decisions.

---

## AI Integration & Personal Assistant

One of the standout features of HorseHub AI is its **AI-powered personal assistant**.

The AI assistant helps users with:
- Understanding horse breeds and characteristics
- Feeding and care recommendations
- Listing guidance for sellers
- Smart suggestions based on user behavior

We designed the AI interaction to feel conversational, supportive, and non-intrusive—making advanced technology feel approachable and useful rather than overwhelming.
![Gallery 2](https://i.ibb.co/SSk43cH/Dribbble-shot-HD-05.png)

---

## Marketplace & E-Commerce Functionality

HorseHub AI functions as a **full-featured e-commerce marketplace**, tailored specifically for horse trading.

Key marketplace features include:
- Rich horse listings with images, price, breed, age, and location
- Detailed horse profile pages
- Seller profiles with verification status
- Favorites and discovery flows
- Secure communication between buyers and sellers

The marketplace architecture ensures scalability, allowing thousands of listings and users without performance degradation.

---

## Payment & Financial Integration

To support real-world transactions, we integrated multiple secure payment options, including:

- Bank transfer support
- Google Pay integration
- Secure payment gateways
- Seller bank detail verification

All payment-related data is handled with strict validation and security practices to ensure **trust, transparency, and reliability** for both buyers and sellers.

---

## Verification & Trust System

Trust is critical in high-value transactions like horse trading. We implemented a **multi-layer verification system**, including:

- Verified seller badges
- Admin-reviewed listings
- Professional service verification (veterinarians, clinics)
- Controlled listing approval workflows via admin panel

This ensures that users always interact with **authentic and credible profiles**.
![Gallery 1](https://i.ibb.co/ZRV7sqjM/iconic-app-20.png)
---

## Database & Backend Architecture

The app is backed by a structured and scalable database system that manages:

- User authentication and roles
- Listings, images, and metadata
- Payment records and transaction states
- AI interaction logs
- Admin moderation tools

The backend architecture was designed to support **high availability**, **data integrity**, and **future feature expansion**.

---

## Admin Panel & Management System

We built a dedicated **admin dashboard** that allows platform administrators to:

- Manage users and sellers
- Review and approve listings
- Monitor transactions
- Control AI content and moderation
- Maintain platform integrity

This ensures smooth operations and long-term maintainability of the platform.

---

## Cross-Platform Compatibility

HorseHub AI was designed with a **mobile-first, cross-platform approach**, ensuring:

- Full compatibility with both **iOS and Android**
- Consistent UI/UX across devices
- Optimized performance on different screen sizes
- Smooth navigation and fast load times

The design and architecture allow the app to scale easily across future platforms and devices.

---

## Client Feedback & Outcome

Our client was particularly impressed by:
- The premium look and feel of the app
- The seamless AI integration
- The clarity of the marketplace flow
- The strong focus on trust and verification

HorseHub AI successfully transformed a traditionally offline, fragmented process into a **modern, intelligent, and scalable digital product**.

---
![Gallery 4](https://i.ibb.co/pBnS94md/Dribbble-shot-HD-03.png)
## Final Result

HorseHub AI stands as a complete solution that merges:
- AI intelligence  
- E-commerce marketplace functionality  
- Secure payments  
- Verified trust systems  
- Scalable backend architecture  
- Cross-platform mobile excellence  

The result is a future-ready product designed to grow with its users and redefine how horse trading works in the digital era.

title: NYC Medical Care
description: NYC Medical Advanced Care is a modern hospital management platform with online appointment booking, AI chatbot assistance, doctor directory, and a comprehensive admin dashboard for managing appointments, patients, doctors, billing, pharmacy, labs, and hospital operations. Built with Next.js and TypeScript.
role: Full Stack Development, UI/UX, API and AI integration, Management, SQA
content: # NYC Medical Advanced Care ## Digital Transformation Case Study --- ## 📋 Executive Summary **NYC Medical Advanced Care** represents a comprehensive digital transformation of traditional hospital management systems. This next-generation platform seamlessly integrates patient-facing services with robust administrative tools, powered by AI-driven assistance to revolutionize healthcare delivery and operational efficiency. **Project Duration:** 12 weeks **Team Size:** 5 members (Design, Frontend, Backend, AI/ML, QA) **Industry:** Healthcare Technology **Platform Type:** Full-Stack Web Application --- ## 🎯 Project Goals & Vision ### Primary Objectives 1. **Eliminate Patient Friction** Traditional hospital systems force patients through phone queues, paper forms, and confusing navigation. Our goal was to create a **seamless digital experience** where booking appointments, finding specialists, and accessing information happens in seconds, not hours. 2. **Operational Excellence** Hospital administrators juggle multiple disconnected systems for appointments, billing, inventory, and patient records. We aimed to **unify all operations** into a single, intuitive dashboard that reduces administrative overhead by 60%. 3. **24/7 Intelligent Support** With limited staff and overwhelming patient inquiries, hospitals struggle to provide round-the-clock assistance. Our **AI-powered chatbot** delivers instant, accurate responses to common medical queries, freeing staff for critical care. 4. **Data-Driven Decision Making** Healthcare leaders need real-time insights into hospital performance. **Start with the Problem, Not the Tech**: We interviewed 30+ users before writing a single line of code. - **Design Systems Save Time**: Invest 2 weeks upfront in a component library to save months later. - **AI Needs Guardrails**: Our chatbot initially gave medical advice—we added strict prompts to prevent liability. - **Performance is a Feature**: Users abandon sites that load slowly; we prioritized Lighthouse scores from day one. --- ## � Project Walkthrough Video ### Watch the Complete Platform Demo [![NYC Medical Advanced Care -
